name: Bathsheba
overview: The story of Bathsheba, referenced in Psalms 51:1 and Matthew 1:6, highlights both human sin and God's redemptive mercy. David’s plea for mercy after his transgression with Bathsheba reveals the depth of his repentance and God’s tender kindness. Bathsheba’s role as the wife of Uriah and mother of Solomon places her within the messianic lineage, demonstrating how God’s sovereign plan includes flawed individuals. Acts 13:22 affirms David as a man after God's own heart, underscoring that despite sin, God's purposes prevail through repentance and grace.
